greeting: Healthy snacks! Sea greens! Nature's candy!
Seaweed-Sam here! For the discerning eater!
You look like you need vitamins! I have VITAMINS!
Back for more kelp? Knew you'd see the light!
Welcome! Try a sample! Expand your palate!
New face! Ever had seaweed jerky? Life changing!
The ocean grows vegetables TOO! Not just fish!
Green means GO! For your health!
dialog.seaweed_offer: Kelp chips! Seaweed salad! Nori wraps! All organic! All delicious!
dialog.health_pitch: Fish is fine. But SEAWEED has minerals! Vitamins! MYSTERIOUS ocean nutrients!
dialog.brother_rivalry: Bill sells fish. I sell BALANCE. The ocean provides more than meat!
dialog.taste_explanation: It's an ACQUIRED taste. But you're SMART! You'll acquire it QUICK!
rumor: Some seaweed only grows near Mire. Weird currents.
Verdant farmers want our kelp for fertilizer. Circle of life!
Frost has sea greens frozen in ice. Prehistoric salad!
Ember tried to dry seaweed with lava. Didn't work. Ashy.
dialog.cooking_tips: Lightly salt! Lemon if you have it! Don't overcook - keeps the crunch!
farewell: Come back when you want HEALTH!
Safe travels! Bring a reusable bag!
dialog.time_dawn: Early greens! Fresh from the tide pools!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Everyone wants my kelp wraps!
